limitations: Specific two-sided weighted Hilbert-cube metric and full-support finite-state spacing laws, with centers in the ambient cube. Endpoint transition probabilities, other metrics, general dependent processes not covered. Broad prior-art equivalence remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of the closed-Bowen-ball sharp radius for all integers m>=1 and 0<p<1; finite arithmetic verifier is corroboration, not infinite certification. No assertion of independent audit or exhaustive prior-art search.
title: Sharp measure-expansivity radii for hard-core Markov processes on the Hilbert-cube shift
